title: IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations
abstract: arXiv:2608.02110v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering intent deviation and repetitive API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across several fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. translated_title: IACM-RL：面向动态意图波动下复杂工具调用的意图感知上下文管理与强化学习
translated_abstract: 在真实环境中执行长程工具调用严重受到动态用户意图噪声的挑战。现有方法试图通过隐式历史扫描或文本压缩来获得鲁棒性，但在简单化场景中大多假设指令是完美无缺的。不可避免地，在上下文波动的情况下，过时的约束会稀释模型注意力，引发意图偏离和重复的API循环。为解决这一问题，我们提出IACM-RL，一个面向鲁棒工具调用的综合性框架。首先，我们引入DynamicIntent管线，跨多个细粒度波动场景合成轨迹，并配备五维诊断指标套件。其次，IACM-RL部署了基于BeliefState的自生成上下文管理器，主动追踪不断变化的目标，并使用结构性过期标志隔离被覆盖的参数。为了自主内化这种状态追踪能力，我们对策略进行优化（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出IACM-RL框架，通过基于BeliefState的自生成上下文管理器主动追踪用户意图变化并隔离过时参数，结合DynamicIntent数据管线与强化学习优化，解决了动态意图波动下长程工具调用中的意图偏离与重复API调用问题。
en_tdlr: IACM-RL introduces a BeliefState-based self-generated context manager with reinforcement learning, together with the DynamicIntent pipeline and a five-dimensional diagnostic suite, to robustly handle dynamic user intent fluctuations in long-horizon tool invocation, preventing intent deviation and repetitive API loops.
